hiring.positions_note: Four academic posts were open today across UC: one in Biology and Sustainability, one in Comparative Politics, and two teaching posts in Physics. None is in the Facultad de Medicina, Medicina Interna, or rheumatology.
hiring.requires_chilean_title_note: No current call requires Chilean nationality or states a foreign-degree revalidation requirement. The published foreign-applicant requirement is: “Una persona de nacionalidad extranjera que postula desde el extranjero requerirá, en caso de quedar seleccionada para el cargo, contar con la visa correspondiente, obtenida en el consulado del país de origen, para su incorporación a la planta académica de la Universidad.” The current Physics call likewise says: “Si la persona seleccionada para este cargo es extranjera, requerirá contar con la visa correspondiente para su incorporación en la planta académica de la Universidad.”

international.notes: The School's International Cooperation Office lists opportunities for visiting faculty and staff, teaching/professional-development stays of up to one semester, fellowships, and residencies. The official site has an “Internationalization at home” area that lists “Teaching English,” but I found no official evidence of a medical course taught in English.

profile_paragraphs: UC’s Facultad de Medicina was created on 17 June 1929. Its School of Medicine reports that it opened classes in 1930; the faculty’s current dean is Dr. Bruno Nervi Nattero (2026–2030).

The Faculty’s Department of Clinical Immunology and Rheumatology combines clinical rheumatologists with basic-science researchers. Its page identifies a two-year specialty programme in Clinical Immunology and Adult Rheumatology.

For clinical-specialty entry, UC states that Chilean or foreign physicians must have passed EUNACOM and be specialists in Internal Medicine. This is a material barrier for a foreign rheumatologist considering clinical training or practice.

Clinical teaching sites include UC CHRISTUS, Sótero del Río, La Florida and Josefina Martínez. UC’s international office explicitly offers routes for visiting faculty/staff and professional-development stays, but no Medicine-faculty academic post was open on 3 September 2026.
